long_biography.plain_text:
Lawrence Ma Ting Hung led CITIC Resources at the intersection of finance and natural resources before turning to consumer credit. He had earlier worked in corporate finance at Bankers Trust after earning an economics degree from the University of Southern California. The experience gave him a foundation in both capital markets and listed-company management.

In 2006, Ma and Stephen Liu established the business that became VCREDIT, using the founders' personal finances to launch one of China's early independent consumer-finance providers. Ma shaped strategy from the board and became an executive director in 2022. His wholly controlled holding companies give him majority voting control, while he continues as chairman of a business built around online lending, data-led risk management and loan facilitation.
